1418-1651-3875-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1418-1651-3875-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1418-1651-3875-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

4419-4694-5330-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4419-4694-5330-7306.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-3841-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3841-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Torens triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

728-2060-2744-5660--29.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with mana value 1 or less
728-2060-2744-5660--29.description:
Cast the creature with mana value 1 or less from your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
728-2060-2744-5660--29.notes: This combo will not put infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler unless the creature has mana value 0.

728-3951-4452-5703.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
728-3951-4452-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

252-4231-5394-7175.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-4231-5394-7175.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

2595-5641-6854.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7296-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7296-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

647-2590-5776-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

2034-5224-6294-7692.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2228-4762-7503.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Elegant Entourage triggers, giving Devoted Druid +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Devoted Druid ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

5641-6719-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-6719-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1182-5660-6872.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Stonecoil Serpent from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

618-5241--112.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Sakashima's Student that has haste. Choose to have Sakashima's Student enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Sakashima's Student token instead.
618-5241--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must increase Sakashima's Student's toughness.

1395-2033-3459-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

343-1115-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
343-1115-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

147-4050-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

570-1781-1978.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three colors among permanents you control.
570-1781-1978.description:
Cause Faeburrow Elder to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat from step 2.

1385-2173-2448-5220.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
1385-2173-2448-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

826-1399-1606-3664.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Lotus Field.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2

4338-5929-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Leyline of Transformation, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2073-2279-6808.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 13 or higher.
You control a creature with power 2 or greater.
2073-2279-6808.description:
Activate The Last Ride's crew ability by tapping a creature with power 2 or greater, causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
The Last Ride dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

64-974-1235.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of the Smaug token and Warden of the Eye with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Smaug token that died and the Warden of the Eye token trigger.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

224-2157-5954-6664.notablePrerequisites: Romana II does not have summoning sickness.
224-2157-5954-6664.description:
Cast Overlord of the Hauntwoods by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Romana II.
Activate the Everywhere token by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a tapped copy of the Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5485-6633.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-5485-6633.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

855-3693-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
855-3693-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista if desired.

5173-5553-5626-6580.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

108-4365-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
When Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

971-4518-5283-5296.notablePrerequisites:
Workhorse has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Pentad Prism has at least one charge counter on it.
971-4518-5283-5296.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Inexorable Tide triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse and a charge counter on Pentad Prism.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Pentad Prism by removing a charge counter from it, adding {W}.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

277-1737-2092-2544-4754.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
277-1737-2092-2544-4754.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Razortide Bridge.
When Razortide Bridge enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping it.
Activate the Razortide Bridge token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

660-2882-3079-4999.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Treva's Attendant.
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
660-2882-3079-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Treva's Attendant due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Hollow One by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {G}{W}{U}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.

1866-2412-2882-4999.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Crosis's Attendant.
1866-2412-2882-4999.description:
Cast Sandbar Merfolk either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {U}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Crosis's Attendant due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Sandbar Merfolk by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {U}{B}{R}.
If you cast Sandbar Merfolk from your graveyard, Sandbar Merfolk is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Sandbar Merfolk's cycling ability.
Repeat.

49-1799-2034-3621.notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of eight or greater.
49-1799-2034-3621.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

364-1987-3227.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
364-1987-3227.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Scrivener and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.
